description: Header file defining a DX11-specific wrapper for ID3D11View pointers used by Renderbuffers, including classes for render targets, texture render targets, and surface render targets.

classes.name: RenderTarget11
classes.description: Abstract base class for DX11 render targets, providing interface for texture, views, and subresource management.

classes.name: TextureRenderTarget11
classes.description: Concrete class for texture-based render targets, managing D3D11 resources and views.

classes.name: SurfaceRenderTarget11
classes.description: Concrete class for surface-based render targets, associated with swap chains.

methods.name: RenderTarget11
methods.description: Constructor initializing the render target with a format set.

methods.name: getTexture
methods.description: Returns the texture helper for the render target.

methods.name: getShaderResourceView
methods.description: Returns the shader resource view for a given context.

methods.name: getBlitShaderResourceView
methods.description: Returns the shader resource view used for blitting.

methods.name: getWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of the render target.

methods.name: getHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of the render target.

methods.name: getDepth
methods.description: Returns the depth of the render target.

methods.name: SurfaceRenderTarget11
methods.description: Constructor for surface render target linked to a swap chain.
